launcher_icon._doc: The launcher icon, generated from this declaration by 1_cicd/src/scripts/cloud-android-launcher-icons.py (pattern + category colours + glyphs in 1_cicd/src/data/launcher-icons.json). Never edit the generated res files.

name: cloud-superintel
description: Cloud SuperIntel (SI, #1162) - the fleet's Gemini-style AI chat as its own app, now with three sections (Notebook: source-grounded Q&A with citations and an explicit not-in-your-sources answer; SI: the router chat; CGCs: the experts, one persona chat each in six groups): a chat screen, a left side drawer listing the sessions (new chat, rename, delete), a model selector and an agent picker, answers streaming in, replies drawn as Markdown. The page, the sessions, the streaming and the Markdown are libs:ai's (shared with Cloud Drive's AI tab, Cloud Code's chat and the SuperApp assistant), so the look is the fleet's AI default; this app adds only the shell: the shared first row (Profile at the top right opens Cloud Account), the second row with icons, the bottom nav, the shared page gradient and the shared scroll collapse. Backends: the fleet agent gateway (my-ai-api on the mesh: Claude through claude-superset-api on oci-apps, Hermes, Goose, OpenClaw and the OpenRouter models), the address baked from the fleet catalogue; no token is held or read by this app (decisions-use guard D5) and none is in the repository. Dark is the default theme (#336); English is the base language (#299).

android._doc_application_id: The fleet name with its separator dropped, as cloudcalc / cloudsearch.

signing._doc: ONE shared Cloud-constellation signing key for ALL Android apps. KEY LOCATION: Shared/Providers/D_TOOLS-DEVICES/d2-android/release.jks (OU=Cloud Constellation) + Shared/Providers/D_TOOLS-DEVICES/d2-android/signing.secrets.yaml.

auto_update._doc_max_installs_per_pass: Most install sessions ONE unattended background pass may open. A background pass cannot show the system install dialog (Android 10+ blocks background activity starts), so each install it starts leaves a tap-to-install notification holding a PackageInstaller session until the user answers it. Unbounded, one pass over the 40-entry fleet opens 40 and the installer hits Android's 50-session cap - 'Too many active sessions for UID'. The remainder is picked up by the next pass. User-initiated 'Update all' is NOT capped: it runs in the foreground where the dialog appears and sessions resolve at once.
auto_update._doc_enabled: Off because this app compiles no libs:updater: the Store updates it, as it does Cloud Calc and Cloud Search.

modules._doc: Single source of truth for the Gradle module graph; settings.gradle iterates it. No `logic` lib is compiled in (lib-classes L4): the Store installs and updates this app, as it does Cloud Calc.

The backend is the fleet agent gateway (my-ai-api, mesh only; its address is baked as BuildConfig.AI_GATEWAY_URL by libs/ai/ai-gateway.gradle); no token is held or read here (decisions-use guard D5).

tests._doc: Read by 1_cicd/dist/scripts/cloud-android-test-engine.sh, which the ship workflow runs before it builds.

unit._doc: `gradle test`: this app's JVM suite in app/src/test (the persona and CGC group lists read from assets/si/personas.json, the notebook's grounding and refusal, the composer declaration) plus libs:ai's.

ui._doc: #868 THE nav declaration (libs:bottomnav NavDecl) of Cloud SuperIntel: three sections on the bottom nav, Notebook, SI and CGCs, and Settings behind the first row. Notebook (Notebooks, Sources, Chat, Studio) is a one-row section; SI is the router chat alone (one page, so no second row); CGCs is the experts section in `horizontal_two_rows` mode (libs:ui-nav-bars NavSectionLayout; the user may switch it to one row or the side menu in Configs): one persona chat per entry of assets/si/personas.json that has a `group`, in six groups (Deep Science: Math, Physics, Chemistry; Engineers: Energy, Manufacturing, Robotics; Production: CTO; Medicine: Biology, Neuroscience; Business: Lawyer, Asset Manager; General: Wiki AI). The SI and CGCs page ids ARE the personas' ids and the CGC groups ARE personas.json's `group` values (test-superintel-app.sh and PersonasTest hold them in step, both ways). Settings has Models, Backend, About. Every icon is a libs:ui-icons name. The Profile icon at the top right of the first row opens extapp:cloud-account; the sessions drawer is the hamburger's.

configs_pages._doc: Configs > General and Configs > About (libs:ui-nav-bars fleetconfigs, rule 1_cicd/src/data/configs-pages.json). general.sections: the anchors and sections of the one General page, in order (perms, battery, storage, notifications, ui, language are required; app opens this app's own Configs). about: what the app does, its features, privacy and the fleet services it talks to (ids of ac_cloud-account/build.json::fleet_endpoints, resolved to mesh URLs at build time). Name, icon, version, build sha, repo, licence, crash sink and debug API are derived, never typed here.

about.what: The fleet's AI chat: source-grounded notebooks, a router chat and one expert persona per field.
features: Notebook: Q&A grounded in your sources, with citations
CGCs: expert chats from maths to law
about.privacy: No ads and no third-party trackers. A crash report is saved on the phone and sent only to the phone's own C3 WebServer over loopback; nothing leaves the device unless you share it. It talks only to the fleet services listed below, over the private mesh first.

perms._doc: #1360 every grant this app needs, by libs:perms catalogue id (needs), and the fleet apps that do work for it with the grants THEY must hold (helpers). The ONE declaration: generated into assets/app-perms.json (cloud-android-perms-guard.py --write), drawn by Configs > General > Perms (libs:perms AppPermsSection) with live state, Grant / Open and Grant all, asked at first run (first_run), and reported as 'Missing permission X - Grant' when an operation fails (PermsGate). perms-guard fails when code uses a gated API or another app's engine that is not declared here, or when the manifest and this list disagree.
